paragraphs.text: Beaver is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of large, semi-aquatic, broad-tailed rodents that are known to build dams in flowing water.
Beaver originally debuted as a silver-bordered creature type in Unstable on the host creature Eager Beaver . The type became eternal with the release of Giant Beaver in Outlaws of Thunder Junction .
Beavers have been seen to exist on both Thunder Junction and Bloomburrow .
On Bloomburrow, a beaver named Timbles has felled multiple trees to the annoyance of nearby birdfolk guards.
Thunder Junction is home to giant beavers that are used as mounts by its inhabitants.
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles introduced the Dream Beavers which is a beaver nightmare representing the Dream Beavers , four beavers from another dimension that can infiltrate dreams.
